grh_daa1fae72f067e91bd1d.title: Kiss Me Kate
paragraphs: Divorced actors Fred Graham and Lilli Vanessi reunite onstage in The Taming of the Shrew and immediately resume the jealousy, insults and attraction that wrecked their marriage.
